topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: I just found out my apartment building is being converted into condos. It feels like the ground’s been ripped out from under me. I’ve only just settled in, made this place my home. Now, they're talking about timelines, about how we might have to move out, find somewhere new. It’s overwhelming. The conversations with the neighbors are already tense, everyone’s on edge, trying to figure out our options. I don’t even know where to start. The clock’s ticking, and I’m trapped in this maze of uncertainty.
